title: Stormilla + Wilder Wild compat
description: Stormilla + Wilder Wild mod Compatibility Pack
body:
This resource pack adds special textures for Wilder Wild's: wooden fences, gates, pressure plates, and buttons in the style of Stormilla for better compatibility. Tired of certain blocks using vanilla textures and looking out of place with Stormilla? Then this Add-On is for you!
Also check out the [Stormilla + Trailier Tales compat](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stormilla-+-trailier-tales-compat).

Place this pack above Fabric mods and Stormilla resource packs.

Credits:
